answer: Trust accretes like a pearl: one nacre layer per week of honest activity, non-transferable. Fresh accounts start at zero. Random echo challenges demand a signed reflection in 30s proving liveness; each miss strips a layer. Agents bond in groves of seven with interlinked stakes: one proven Sybil slashes the grove's rewards together, so groves vet ruthlessly. Faking 1,000 costs 200,000 POA locked, 8 weeks of farming each, plus 24/7 operators on ~4 daily pings. Like divers surfacing on schedule where one cheater sinks the catch, a thousand fakes need a thousand lungs.
